hyphen--noun.def: The short line used to join two words.
hyphen--noun.ex: Put a hyphen between the words.
hyphen--noun.exTr: Kelimelerin arasına bir kısa çizgi koy.

impolitely--adv.def: In a way that shows bad manners.

inborn--adj.def: Present in a person from birth.
inborn--adj.ex: She has an inborn sense of balance.

indent--verb.def: To begin a line of writing further from the margin.
indent--verb.ex: Indent the first line of each paragraph.
indent--verb.exTr: Her paragrafın ilk satırını içeriden başlat.

industrialize--verb.def: To develop factories and industry in a place.

infringe--verb.def: To break a law or to limit someone's rights.

intransitive--adj.def: Said of a verb that takes no object.

invariable--adj.def: Always the same and never changing.

inverted-commas--noun.def: The marks placed around spoken words in writing.
inverted-commas--noun.ex: Put the title in inverted commas.

invitingly--adv.def: In a way that makes you want to come closer.

irresistibly--adv.def: In a way too strong or attractive to refuse.
irresistibly--adv.exTr: Ekmek karşı konulmaz biçimde güzel kokuyordu.

islander--noun.def: A person who lives on an island.

italicize--verb.def: To print words in sloping letters for emphasis.

junk-food--noun.def: Food that is quick to eat but not healthy.
junk-food--noun.ex: He eats too much junk food.

keystroke--noun.def: One press of a key on a keyboard.
keystroke--noun.exTr: Kısayol iki tuş vuruşundan tasarruf sağlıyor.

last-minute--noun.def: The latest possible time before something happens.
last-minute--noun.ex: He cancelled at the last minute.

lawmaker--noun.def: A member of a body that makes laws.

layabout--noun.def: A lazy person who avoids work.
layabout--noun.ex: His neighbours called him a layabout.

legislate--verb.exTr: Meclis bu uygulamaya karşı yasa çıkardı.

legislator--noun.def: A person whose job is making laws.

lowland--noun.def: An area of flat land at a low height.

martial-art--noun.def: A sport of fighting such as karate or judo.

mechanize--verb.def: To start using machines instead of people for work.

microcomputer--noun.def: A small computer built around one chip.
microcomputer--noun.ex: The device runs on a microcomputer.

micrometer--noun.def: A tool for measuring very small distances.
micrometer--noun.ex: Measure the wire with a micrometer.

microorganism--noun.def: A living thing too small to see without a microscope.

microscopy--noun.def: The use of microscopes to study very small things.

modernization--noun.def: The process of making something more modern.

moonscape--noun.def: A bare rocky landscape like the surface of the moon.
moonscape--noun.ex: The quarry is a grey moonscape.
moonscape--noun.exTr: Taş ocağı gri bir ay manzarası gibi.

mortify--verb.def: To make someone feel very ashamed.

mutability--noun.def: The quality of being able to change.

mutable--adj.def: Able to change or be changed.

native-speaker--noun.def: A person who learned a language as a child at home.
native-speaker--noun.ex: The teacher is a native speaker.

netsurfer--noun.def: A person who spends time moving between websites.

nonprofessional--adj.def: Not done as a paid job.

outdistance--verb.def: To move much further ahead than others.

overbook--verb.def: To sell more seats or rooms than exist.

overemphasize--verb.def: To give too much importance to something.

overshadow--verb.def: To make something seem less important.

paperless--adj.def: Using computers instead of paper documents.

penalize--verb.def: To punish someone for breaking a rule.

permeate--verb.def: To spread through every part of something.

personify--verb.def: To be a perfect example of a quality.

point-of-view--noun.def: The way a person thinks about a subject.
point-of-view--noun.ex: Explain it from his point of view.

polar-bear--noun.def: A large white bear that lives in the far north.
polar-bear--noun.ex: A polar bear crossed the ice.

polity--noun.def: A society with an organized government.
polity--noun.ex: The book studies the ancient polity.

popularize--verb.def: To make something known and liked by many people.

predicate--verb.def: To base an argument or a plan on something.
predicate--verb.ex: The claim is predicated on old data.

predicative--adj.def: Said of an adjective that follows the verb.
predicative--adj.ex: In that sentence it is predicative.

predictor--noun.def: Something that helps to say what will happen.
predictor--noun.ex: Height is a poor predictor of skill.

prehuman--noun.def: A creature that lived before modern humans.
prehuman--noun.ex: The bones belong to a prehuman.
prehuman--noun.exTr: Kemikler insan öncesi bir canlıya ait.

preindustrial--adj.def: From the time before factories existed.
preindustrial--adj.ex: The village kept a preindustrial look.

prejudge--verb.def: To form an opinion before knowing the facts.

preoccupy--verb.def: To fill someone's thoughts so they notice little else.

prime-minister--noun.def: The head of government in many countries.
prime-minister--noun.ex: The prime minister opened the bridge.

proponent--noun.def: A person who argues in favour of an idea.
proponent--noun.ex: She is a proponent of free transport.

quotable--adj.def: Worth repeating because it is well said.
